notice: Synthetic shape fixtures only. example.invalid URLs and placeholder hashes/library versions are not real provider grants or runtime attestations. Semantic cases are required behavior, not executed integration tests.

semantic_cases.name: confirmation-response-loss
semantic_cases.expectation: Same key/body returns durable job; no second admission.

semantic_cases.name: input-content-hash-mismatch
semantic_cases.expectation: After initial202, status/replayed confirm returns200 processing_state=rejected, failure_code=input_corrupt; no compute provisioned.

semantic_cases.name: lease-expired-callback
semantic_cases.expectation: Pending callback reserves no authority beyond lease.

semantic_cases.name: duplicate-outcome
semantic_cases.expectation: Recorded digest returns original receipt with unexpired hashed credential.

semantic_cases.name: empty-result
semantic_cases.expectation: failed_qa has no Parquet; report/manifest required.

semantic_cases.name: artifact-expired
semantic_cases.expectation: Deny at expiry even during deletion outage.

semantic_cases.name: retention-after-retry
semantic_cases.expectation: Earliest result completion +30 days survives retry.

semantic_cases.name: multipart-resume-at-expiry
semantic_cases.expectation: First initiation +24h abort is never extended.

semantic_cases.name: bootstrap-response-loss
semantic_cases.expectation: Consumed token cannot replay; cleanup before replacement.

semantic_cases.name: controller-create-timeout
semantic_cases.expectation: Resolve uncertain Pod before second create.

semantic_cases.name: foreign-browser-origin
semantic_cases.expectation: Foreign Origin fails despite Basic/custom header.

semantic_cases.name: worker-on-client
semantic_cases.expectation: Attempt token cannot admit client upload.

semantic_cases.name: private-assets-without-auth
semantic_cases.expectation: Deny private entry/assets before delivering bytes.

semantic_cases.name: binding-stat-count-mismatch
semantic_cases.expectation: Reject differing check counts and corresponding aggregate stats even if each field's JSON shape is valid.
